items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Duke and Sid, they used to make a speech everytime we went to Canada

ctx.x: anything, and the Canadians were very cordial to the band bus, but when we came back out of Canada, going to Seattle, the Americans searched everything. I remember Al Kelley telling everybody in the bus before we got to the border, he said, 'if anybody has anything, get rid of it quick, because they're not going to be easy; they're not going to overlook anything.'

Oh, what's his name? Duke and Sid, they used to make a speech everytime we went to Canada; they used to say, 'Now be careful; get rid of everything you have in your pockets before you get on the train to Canada, because they will search everything.'
What about Al Kelley? Do you ever hear from him?
